g.text: Title: NINA-B306 controller and reserved interfaces

g.desc: Title: NINA-B306 controller and reserved interfaces

g.text: Units A-C split the 55 pads. Pad map verified against NINA-B3 Table 7. EGP/EAGP ground groups need a custom footprint.

g.desc: Units A-C split the 55 pads. Pad map verified against NINA-B3 Table 7. EGP/EAGP ground groups need a custom footprint.

g.text: 10 uF bulk and 100 nF at VCC/VCC_IO; C303 at the VBUS sense

g.desc: 10 uF bulk and 100 nF at VCC/VCC_IO; C303 at the VBUS sense

g.text: microSD on the storage sheet; trigger and photodiode on the event_inputs sheet; charger pins reserved.

g.desc: microSD on the storage sheet; trigger and photodiode on the event_inputs sheet; charger pins reserved.

g.text: EGP/EAGP symbolic ground groups need a matching custom footprint. Do not reuse the NINA-B111 footprint.

g.desc: EGP/EAGP symbolic ground groups need a matching custom footprint. Do not reuse the NINA-B111 footprint.

g.text: Provisional 100k pulls so event, monitor and interrupt inputs never float.

g.desc: Provisional 100k pulls so event, monitor and interrupt inputs never float.

g.text: Shared bus for TUSB320 CC controller, photodiode threshold DAC and the future charger.

g.desc: Shared bus for TUSB320 CC controller, photodiode threshold DAC and the future charger.

g.text: CONTROLLER - u-blox NINA-B306 (nRF52840), GPIO MAP PER NINA-B3 R15 TABLE 7
